prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is active on your desktop! Click and drag to reposition, or right-click to open interaction controls.", "Desktop Interaction Controls"]
1: ["Finalize Your Companion Adoption", "Review your companion details and complete the official adoption record."]
2: ["Sign in with your primary email to instantly restore your desktop pets across all devices."]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Environment", "Synthesizing pet animations and configuring desktop background integration."]
4: ["Choose Your Companion Journey", "Select how you would like to create or pick your desktop pet today."]
5: ["Mastering Desktop Commands", "Try right-clicking your pet, dragging it across screens, or toggling hide mode."]
6: ["Verify Photo Quality", "Ensure your photo is clear and well-lit so your desktop pet generates perfectly."]
7: ["Quick Sign-In", "Connect your account to save your pet progress seamlessly."]
8: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Bring an interactive, personalized pet to life on your desktop screen in just a few quick steps."]
9: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet", "Feel free to use other apps. We will notify you as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop!"]
